To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) a mixture of DCNs is an effective way to learn a fine-grained classification model, b) joint end-to-end learning of the DCNs improves the performance of the mixture model, and c) the proposed method can achieve state-of-the-art performance on fine-grained classification tasks.

(1) we propose a novel deep convolution neural network system called a mixture of deep convolution networks (MixDCNN); (2) we provide a formulation for joint end-to-end learning of the mixture; (3) we demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed system by achieving significant improvements on three fine-grained image datasets.

developing a new deep learning framework that can be used to solve fine-grained image categorisation problems.
